channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jerry Buss | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jerry Buss from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Jerry Buss
item.description:
Responding to an article written by The California Post’s Lakers beat reporter Khobi Price suggesting that Jerry Buss should be next to be honored with a statue, Magic Johnson took to social media to emphatically agree.

“I 100% agree that Dr. Jerry Buss the greatest franchise owner in sports history and deserves a statue in front of Crypto arena soon in his honor,”

Magic Johnson on Jerry Buss, Sep 14, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Brandon Schneider on Jerry Buss
item.description:
“Supposedly, Jerry Buss did this to ensure that one of his kids would always own the team but it also creates a huge incentive to sell while still alive.”

Brandon Schneider on Jerry Buss, Aug 21, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Michael Cooper on Jerry Buss
item.description:
Michael Cooper:

“You know what? The Forum Club was a different place. It was almost like Studio 54 in New York at the time, and Dr. Buss wanted that. He paraded women that came to the game around, and then he’d take his entourage and go sit up by the flag. That was part of LA.”

Michael Cooper on Jerry Buss, Feb 7, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Mitch Kupchak, Josh Howard, Jerry Buss, Jason Terry
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“You know how close we were to trading for Kobe in 2007. Oh my God, it was like literally this close. I talked to Jerry Buss and worked something out. Kobe wanted to leave. Jerry said, 'if you want to leave, we'll take care of it.'We were going to trade Josh Howard, Jason Terry, and picks, but no Dirk. I said, ‘Anyone but Dirk.’ Kobe wanted it, and Jerry was willing to do it, but Mitch Kupchak talked Jerry out of it. It was going to happen. I remember telling this dude,’ I’m like, ‘Kobe’s going to be a Mav,’ and I thought it was done. But Mitch Kupchack stepped in, and that’s how it fell apart. The rest is history.”

Mark Cuban on Mitch Kupchak, Josh Howard, Jerry Buss, Jason Terry, Oct 10, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Jerry Buss
item.description:
It is also nearing the 10-year anniversary of the death of her father Jerry Buss, the Lakers' longtime flamboyant owner who died in February 2013.

“In conversations in the past few years, and realizing there is a lot of innovation that he brought to the industry, a new generation of Lakers fans might not know or never even heard of Jerry Buss,”

Jeanie Buss on Jerry Buss, Aug 31, 2022. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Jerry Buss
item.description:
Apparently, Cuban was already in deep discussions with then-Los Angeles Lakers owner Jerry Buss about a potential blockbuster deal:

“I was going back and forth with Dr. Buss, and I forgot who called who, I think he called me, actually, and said, ‘Look, we think we might be parting ways with Kobe,’”

Mark Cuban on Jerry Buss, Aug 16, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Jerry Buss
item.description:
“The Celtics are great. Jerry Buss owned the Lakers for 33 years. Does anybody know how many Finals he made in 33 years? Sixteen out of 33 years. Now that is remarkable. We've now made six in 12 years. So, I love the 50-percent rate. Whether we'll continue that, I don't know. But I'm sure as hell gonna try.”

Joe Lacob on Jerry Buss, May 30, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: LeBron James on Jerry Buss
item.description:
Magic Johnson is discussing his pursuit of LeBron James on a conference call w/reporters.

“Dr. Buss was the ultimate closer and I was trying to steal a page out of his book and bring the greatest player in the world to the Lakers.”

LeBron James on Jerry Buss, Jul 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @billoram.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Jerry Buss
item.description:
“Today I took a series of actions I believe will return the Lakers to the heights Dr. Jerry Buss demanded and our fans rightly expect,”

Jeanie Buss on Jerry Buss, Feb 21, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Steve Nash on Jerry Buss
item.description:
“I'd like to think that regardless of Dr. Buss passing that we'd have the toughness to find it in ourselves to rally. It's been a tough year obviously, and trying, but we've made some progress and we have to continue to make progress the rest of the way. It would be a beautiful thing to do it for Dr. Buss.”

Steve Nash on Jerry Buss, Feb 22, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Jerry Buss
item.description:
Johnson said Tuesday night, a day after Buss died.

“Forget just the basketball player, but the man that I am. I owe a lot to Dr. Buss.”

Magic Johnson on Jerry Buss, Feb 21, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Jerry Buss
item.description:
*@Pau Gasol on Dr. Buss:

“He's an owner that did everything he could to make sure his team had the best chance possible to win the title.”

Pau Gasol on Jerry Buss, Feb 19, 2013. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Sasha Vujacic on Jerry Buss
item.description:
Sasha Vujacic:

“Today we lost a very special man, the legend, dr. Jerry Buss,”

Sasha Vujacic on Jerry Buss, Feb 19, 2013. Source: Kosarka.si.

item.title: Trevor Ariza on Jerry Buss
item.description:
Wizards forward Trevor Ariza helped deliver one of the those titles for Buss during 1½ seasons with his hometown Lakers in 2009 and was understandably touched to hear about his passing.

“That’s tough man, that’s tough for the Lakers organization, the Buss family and city of L.A.,”

Trevor Ariza on Jerry Buss, Feb 19, 2013. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Jerry Buss
item.description:
In that moment, in Buss' house in the hills, it washed over Bryant how much staying a Laker for life meant to him, how no matter how dire the state of the franchise seemed, that Buss had a history of restoring the Lakers to championship contention.

“It hit me that I didn't really want to walk out on Dr. Buss,”

Kobe Bryant on Jerry Buss, Feb 18, 2013. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Jerry Buss
item.description:
Most recently, Johnson said Buss took great pride in Johnson buying into the Los Angeles Dodgers, the team that had owned Los Angeles before Buss turned L.A. into Showtime for the Lakers.

“The first call I got when we bought the Dodgers was from Dr. Buss. I thought he bought the Dodgers, he was so happy,”

Magic Johnson on Jerry Buss, Feb 18, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Jerry Buss
item.description:
But in a wide-ranging interview with this newspaper in October, Kupchak praised Buss on how his vision has largely contributed to the Lakers' success.

“Dr. Buss has always been looked at as a gambler and not afraid of risk,”

Mitch Kupchak on Jerry Buss, Feb 15, 2013. Source: Los Angeles Daily News.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Jerry Buss
item.description:
“Unfortunately, Mitch wasn't that guy for me. We never got along. Mitch looked out for two people: himself and Jerry Buss. The rest of us were afterthoughts.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Jerry Buss, Nov 7, 2011. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Jerry West on Jerry Buss
item.description:
at the ESPN Zone in Los Angeles,he told ESPNLosAngeles.com that he didn’t believe his presence would have prevented the messy divorce and that the O’Neal’s trade probably facilitated the team’s last two championships.

“I think when you work for Jerry Buss the thing that’s the greatest about him is he’s not afraid to make tough decisions,”

Jerry West on Jerry Buss, Nov 3, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on Jerry Buss
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Kareem:

“When you look at what [Jerry Buss] did for Earvin and what he did for me, there's a big disparity there.”

Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on Jerry Buss, May 19, 2011. Source: Twitter.
